what_happened.line: The Planning Board heard an engineer present an ANR plan that divides 322 Flat Hill Road into three lots; no vote is captured in the minutes.
The Assessor said the land is in Chapter 61B recreation, so a town right of first refusal would apply before construction or sale.
A member asked that a memo go to the Open Space Committee, Conservation Commission and Board of Selectmen about a possible Chapter 61B withdrawal.
The ANR itself would not be held up by the memo; the captions end with the notification question unresolved.

why_it_matters: Chapter 61B land carries a town right of first refusal, so a sale or change of use of this parcel could give the town a short window to decide whether to buy, which would involve other boards and possibly a Town Meeting vote.
